clips.title: The story
paras: Lake Everstill is the expansive azure body of water dominating the heart of the Redridge Mountains, flanking the town of Lakeshire. Once celebrated for tranquil fishing and clean mountain runoff, its shores and waters have lately turned treacherous due to aggressive murloc tribes and predatory lake beasts.

Spanning the central basin of Redridge, Lake Everstill provides the scenic backdrop and vital waterway for the township of Lakeshire. Its crystal-clear waters drain eastward toward the looming heights of Stonewatch. Spanned by the town's central bridge, the lake has long sustained local trade and quiet anglers, though anyone walking the shoreline today will find its peaceful reputation thoroughly shattered by encroaching wilderness threats.
